    lab,n=ndimage.label(A==val)
    return [set(map(tuple,np.argwhere(lab==k))) for k in range(1,n+1)]

def solve(I):
    A=np.array(I); H,W=A.shape

    best=None

            if len(c)>=2: cands.append((min(p[0] for p in c),min(p[1] for p in c),v,c))
    cands.sort(key=lambda x:(x[0],x[1]))
    _,_,av,anchor=cands[0]
    for p in anchor: out[p]=av
    placed_cols=set()
    for val in sorted(set(A.flatten().tolist())-{0}):
        for c in comps_of(A,val):
            if c is anchor or len(c)<2: continue
            minc=min(p[1] for p in c)
            d=max(placed_cols)-0  # will compute

            target=(max(placed_cols)+1) if placed_cols else anchor_max_col()+1 if False else None
        # simplify: iterative global scan: repeat until no progress

    # Demo check: single pass: target = previous comp's max col +1 regardless of row overlap -> works for demo.
    prev_max=-1
    cands_sorted=sorted([(min(p[1] for p in c),p[0]) for val in set(A.flatten().tolist())-{0} for c in comps_of(A,val) if len(c)>=2])
    cands_sorted.sort()
    for mc,(mr,) in cands_sorted:
        d=mc-(prev_max+1)

def solve(I):
    A=np.array(I); H,W=A.shape
    colors=set(A.flatten().tolist())-{0}
    items=[]
    for v in colors:
        for c in comps_of(A,v):
            if len(c)>=2: items.append((v,c))
    anchor=min(items,key=lambda i:min(p[1] for p in i[1]))
    out=np.zeros(A.shape,dtype=int)
    ob=set()
    for p in anchor[1]: ob.add(p); out[p]=anchor[0]
    prev_global=max(p[1] for p in anchor[1])
    others=[c for v,c in items if c is not anchor[1]]
    others.sort(key=lambda c:(min(p[0] for p in c),min(p[1] for p in c)))
    for c in others:
        orig=list(c)[0]; v=int(A[orig[0],orig[1]])
        mc=min(p[1] for p in c)
        d=mc-(prev_global+1)
        for p in c: ob.add((p[0],p[1]-d)); out[p[0],p[1]-d]=v
        prev_global=max(prev_global,max(p[1] for p in c)-d)
    cols=[p[1] for p in ob]
    W2=max(cols)+1 if cols else 0
    P=[[int(out[i,j]) if j<W2 else 0 for j in range(W2)] for i in range(H)]
    return P

P=solve(G['Demo pair 1 input'])

import numpy as np
def solve(I, mode='diag'):
    A=np.array(I); H,W=A.shape
    # multi-cell comps per color (4-conn), any non-zero color
    labs=[]
    for v in range(10):
        lab,n=ndimage.label(A==v)
        for k in range(1,n+1):
            c=set(map(tuple,np.argwhere(lab==k)))
            labs.append((v,c))
    objs=[c for v,c in labs if len(c)>=2]
    singles=[c for v,c in labs if len(c)==1]
    # absorption: singletons 4-adjacent to an object adopt its color and merge
    if mode=='absorb':
        for s in singles:
            for ob in objs:
                v=next(v for vv,o in [(a,cc) for a,cc in objs] for o in [] ) # noop
            # find adjacent object
            for idx,(vo,ob) in enumerate(objs):
                if any(abs(p[0]-q[0])<=1 and abs(p[1]-q[1])<=1 and p!=q for p in s for q in ob):
                    vo_ ,ob_=objs[idx][0],objs[idx][1]
                    ob|=s; vo=vo_; break
    else:
        objs=[(v,c) for v,c in labs if len(c)>=2]
    # anchor: obj with smallest mincol
    objs.sort(key=lambda oc:min(p[1] for p in oc[1]))
    anchor=objs[0]
    out=np.zeros(A.shape,dtype=int)
    occ=set()
    for p in anchor[1]: occ.add(p); out[p]=anchor[0]
    prev_global=max(p[1] for p in anchor[1])
    for v,c in objs[1:]:
        mc=min(p[1] for p in c)
        d=mc-(prev_global+1)
        for p in c:
            out[p[0],p[1]-d]=v; occ.add((p[0],p[1]-d))
        prev_global=max(prev_global,max(p[1] for p in c)-d)
    cols=[p[1] for p in occ]
    W2=max(cols)+1
    return [[int(out[i,j]) if j<W2 else 0 for j in range(W2)] for i in range(H)]

def get_trans(I,O):
    I=np.array(I);O=np.array(O);H,W=I.shape;bg=Counter(I.ravel()).most_common(1)[0][0]
    Ci=[set(c) for c in comps_of_same_val(I,bg)]
    Co=[set(zip(*np.where(np.array(G['Demo pair %d'%k+' output']==v)))) for k,v in []]

# simpler: for each output comp, find translation of each input comp matching
for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    I=np.array(G[name+' input']); O=np.array(G[name+' output']); H,W=I.shape; bg=Counter(I.ravel()).most_common(1)[0][0]
    Ci=comps_of_same_val(I,bg); Co=comps_of_same_val(O,bg)
    print('==',name)
    for cc in Co:
        found=[]
        for ci,cin in enumerate(Ci):
            mr=min(r for r,c in cc); mc=min(c for r,c in cc)
            mr2=min(r for r,c in cin); mc2=min(c for r,c in cin)
            if len(cc)!=len(cin): continue
            t=(mr-mr2,mc-mc2)
            if {(r+t[0],c+t[1]) for r,c in cin}==cc:
                found.append((ci,t))
        print('   out comp TL(%d,%d) <-'%(mr,mc), found[:3])

def solve(I,win_r,win_c):

        best.add(s)
    anchor=min(objs,key=lambda o:min(c for r,c in o))
    rest=[o for o in objs if o is not anchor]
    O=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    placed=set()

        assert not any((r,c) in placed for r,c in cells)
        for r,c in cells: O[r][c]=color

        cands=[]

import numpy as np
from collections import Counter
def comps2(M,bg):
    M=np.array(M); H,W=M.shape; seen=set(); res=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):

                st=[(r,c)]; comp=set()
                while st:
                    p=st.pop()
                    if p in comp: continue
                    comp.add(p)
                    for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        q=(p[0]+dr,p[1]+dc)

import numpy as np, traceback
from collections import Counter
def solve(I, keyfn):
    I=np.array(I); Hh,Ww=I.shape
    bg=Counter(I.ravel()).most_common(1)[0][0]
    Cs=comps2(I,bg)
    objs=[set(map(tuple,c)) for c in Cs if len(c)>=2]
    singles=[next(iter(c)) for c in Cs if len(c)==1]
    for s in singles:
        o=min(objs,key=lambda o:min(abs(s[0]-r)+abs(s[1]-c) for r,c in o))
        o.add(s)
    anchor=min(objs,key=lambda o:min(c for r,c in o))
    rest=sorted([o for o in objs if o is not anchor],key=len,reverse=True)
    O=[[bg]*Ww for _ in range(Hh)]
    used=set(anchor)
    for r,c in anchor: O[r][c]=int(I[r,c])
    for oi,o in enumerate(rest):
        mr=min(r for r,c in o); mc=min(c for r,c in o)
        rel=[(r-mr,c-mc) for r,c in o]
        best=None; bdelta=None; cells_=None
        for dr in range(-Hh,Hh+1):
            for dc in range(-Ww,Ww+1):
                cells=[(r+dr,c+dc) for r,c in rel]

                if any((r,c) in used for r,c in cells): continue
                if not(any((r+rr,c+cc) in used for r,c in cells for rr,cc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)))): continue
                k=keyfn(dr,dc)
                if best is None or k<best: best=k; bdelta=(dr,dc); cells_=cells
        if best is None: return ('FAIL',oi,len(rest),bdelta)
        col=max(set(int(I[r,c]) for r,c in o),key=list(o).count)
        for r,c in cells_: O[r][c]=col; used.add((r,c))
    return O

import numpy as np
from collections import Counter
def solve(I):
    I=np.array(I); Hh,Ww=I.shape
    bg=Counter(I.ravel()).most_common(1)[0][0]
    Cs=comps2(I,bg)
    objs=[set(map(tuple,c)) for c in Cs if len(c)>=2]
    singles=[next(iter(c)) for c in Cs if len(c)==1]
    for s in singles:
        o=min(objs,key=lambda o:min(abs(s[0]-r)+abs(s[1]-c) for r,c in o)); o.add(s)
    anchor=min(objs,key=lambda o:min(c for r,c in o))
    rest=sorted([o for o in objs if o is not anchor],key=len,reverse=True)
    O=[[bg]*Ww for _ in range(Hh)]; used=set(anchor)
    for r,c in anchor: O[r][c]=int(I[r,c]); used.add((r,c))
    for oi,o in enumerate(rest):
        mr=min(r for r,c in o); mc=min(c for r,c in o)
        rel=[(r-mr,c-mc) for r,c in o]
        dr=0; dc=-1
        while True:
            cells=[(r+dr,c+dc) for r,c in rel]
            if any(not(0<=r<Hh and 0<=c<Ww) for r,c in cells): break
            adj=any(((rr,cc) in used) for rr,cc in ((r+dr-1,c+dc),(r+dr+1,c+dc),(r+dr,c+dc-1),(r+dr,c+dc+1)) for r,c in cells)

            if abs(dc)>Ww*3: break
        if False: break
        col=max(set(int(I[r,c]) for r,c in o),key=list(o).count)
        for r,c in [(r+dr,c+dc) for r,c in rel]: O[r][c]=col; used.add((r,c))
    return O
